findings.issue: Rejects version above 11; non-RGB input panics via unimplemented! instead of returning an error.
Layer mask pointer is TODO; public parser is not a qualified compositor.
Width times height is multiplied as u32 and Vec allocated without checked dimensions or managed reservation.

decision: Do not integrate this crate directly into the viewer. Native bounded parsing and composition or another verified implementation are required. XCF remains Pending.
next_requirements: Checked version-specific offsets and geometry before allocations
Bounded uncompressed/RLE/zlib tile decoding into managed buffers
Visible layer composition with offsets, alpha, masks, groups and color/precision policy
GIMP-produced corpus with independent exported pixel oracle and RAM/swap/Metal qualification
scope: Source audit only; no XCF decoder implemented and no new format counted.
